uge-168660.summary: UCC3818N PFC Power Factor Correction Controller IC DIP16

blocks.text: The UCC3818N is a high-performance PFC controller from Texas Instruments designed for active power factor-corrected preregulators . It achieves near-unity power factor by shaping the AC input line current waveform to match the AC input line voltage waveform using average current mode control . The device is fabricated on TI’s advanced BiCMOS process, which provides lower power dissipation and improved performance compared to bipolar alternatives .
This is the through-hole PDIP-16 version, ideal for prototyping, hobbyist projects, and applications where manual assembly or socket mounting is preferred.

blocks.text: Arduino NANO MCP2515 CAN Bus Expansion Board

CAN-BUS ( MCP2515 ) is a common industrial bus because of its long travel distance, medium communication speed and high reliability. It is commonly found on modern machine tools and as an automotive diagnostic bus. This CAN-BUS Shield gives your Arduino/Seeeduino CAN-BUS capability. With an OBD-II converter cable added on and the OBD-II library imported, you are ready to build an onboard diagnostic device or data logger.
Implements CAN V2.0B at up to 1 Mb/s
Standard (11 bit) and extended (29 bit) data and remote frames
Two receive buffers with prioritized message storage
The main control board is Arduino Nano development board, CAN control chip-MCP2515, CAN transceiver chip-TJA1050 / MCP2551.
The following is the block diagram for out CAN-BUS Expansion board, wired up as shown:
Note: under the MCP2515 board there is a solder jumper to enable 120R termination resistance
In a CAN bus network, where you are using multiple MCP2551 transceivers (or other CAN transceivers), you need exactly two 120-ohm termination resistors.
The 120-ohm resistors are used to terminate the CAN bus to prevent signal reflections, ensuring reliable communication.
These termination resistors should be placed at both ends of the CAN bus to match the characteristic impedance of the bus, which is typically 120 ohms.
No matter how many MCP2551 transceivers or nodes are on the bus, you only need two 120-ohm resistors.
The resistors should be placed at the two furthest points on the bus, not at every node.
If you have many nodes (say, 5 or 10 MCP2551 modules) connected to a single CAN bus, you still only need two 120-ohm resistors at the ends of the bus.
So, regardless of the number of modules, always ensure that there are two 120-ohm termination resistors on the CAN bus.
From the Arduino IDE: Sketch -> Include Library… -> Add .ZIP Library…
Restart the Arduino IDE to see the new “mcp2515” library with examples
To create connection with MCP2515 provide pin number where SPI CS is connected (10 by default), baudrate and mode

makers-348077.summary: 1N4734A is a 5.6V in DO-41 axial lead package, designed for voltage regulation and protection applications requiring 1 watt power dissipation capability.

blocks.text: The 1N4734A is a silicon Zener diode from the industry-standard 1N4728A-1N4758A series, specifically calibrated to provide precise 5.6V voltage regulation with 1 watt power dissipation capacity. Housed in the reliable DO-41 axial lead package, this through-hole component features a rugged construction suitable for both manual and automated assembly processes. The diode utilizes Zener breakdown phenomenon to maintain a constant voltage across its terminals when reverse-biased beyond its breakdown voltage, making it essential for creating stable voltage references in electronic circuits. With its 5% tolerance on nominal voltage (5.6V ±5%), this device offers predictable performance across various operating conditions and load currents.

This Zener diode exhibits excellent temperature stability and low dynamic impedance characteristics, ensuring consistent voltage regulation even under varying current demands. The 1N4734A is designed to handle reverse current surges up to 110mA at 8.3ms pulse width, providing robust protection against transient voltage events. The device’s 1-watt power dissipation capability, when properly heat-sinked through its leads, makes it suitable for moderate-power regulation applications. Constructed with metallurgical bonding and hermetically sealed glass or plastic package, this diode offers reliable performance across the full -65°C to +200°C operating and storage temperature range. Whether used as a shunt regulator, voltage reference, or protective clamping element, the 1N4734A delivers dependable performance in countless electronic designs requiring 5.6V regulation.

The ESP8089 offers a complete and self-contained Wi-Fi networking solution. When serving as a Wi-Fi adapter, ESP8089 can work with any microcontroller-based systems to achieve wireless connectivity through the SPI/SDIO interface. ESP8089 allows direct connection to cellular baseband and application processors via SPI/ SDIO or memory-mapped parallel interfaces. Its built-in processing and storage capabilities allow it to integrate with the host platform, with minimal development upfront and loading during runtime. ESP8089 is highly-integrated, including the antenna switch balun and power management converters, reducing the external circuitries. The entire solution, including the front-end module, requires minimal PCB area.
The ESP8089-based systems have the following advanced features:
• fast sleep/wake context switching for energy-efficient VoIP
• adaptive radio biasing for low-power operation
• spur cancellation and radio co-existence features for cellular/Bluetooth/802.11 interference mitigation.
• Integrated TR switch, balun, LNA, power amplifier and matching network
• Integrated PLL, regulators, and power management units
• +19 dBm output power in 802.11 b mode
• Power down leakage current of < 10 μA
• SDIO 2.0, SPI, UART • STBC, 1×1 MIMO, 2×1 MIMO
• A-MPDU & A-MSDU aggregation & 0.4 μs guard interval

One major advantage of the TM1638 module is that it calls for just three I/Os (Data, Clock, Strobe) of the concerned microcontroller for the full play. As mentioned, the interface pins are data, clock, and strobe. The strobe (STB) and clock (CLK) pins are only outputs while the data (DIO) pin works for both input and output. The strobe pin is required when sending data to the module.

While sending data you must set the clock pin to ‘low’, then you set the data pin, and then set the clock pin back to ‘high’ to commit the bit value. Perhaps you’re already familiar with this method as it is a common way of sending data with shift registers. And hence it’s possible to use the standard ‘shiftOut’ function to send 8 bits of data with just a single line of code.

The UNI‑T UTG2082B is an advanced dual‑channel arbitrary waveform generator leveraging Direct Digital Synthesis (DDS) to produce high‑precision signals up to 80 MHz. The generator’s 16‑bit vertical resolution and 1.28 GSa/s sampling rate (320 MSa/s in DDS mode) ensure ultra‑low distortion and sharp edges square waves rise in under 12 ns. A 4.3″ TFT color display and intuitive knob‑and‑soft‑key interface simplify configuration, while USB Host (≤ 32 GB), USB Device, LAN, and 10 MHz I/O enable seamless integration into test systems. Built‑in functions include burst, sweep (linear/logarithmic), and extensive modulation (AM, FM, PM, ASK, FSK, PSK, BPSK, QPSK, OSK, SUM, DSBAM, QAM, PWM). Nonvolatile memory stores 160 waveforms (8 pts–16 M pts), and external USB drives support additional arbitrary data.

blocks.text: The GY-271 HMC5883L Triple-Axis Magnetometer Sensor Module is a popular sensor used to measure the magnetic field in three dimensions (X, Y, and Z axes). It uses the HMC5883L magnetometer IC, which is designed for accurate and low-power magnetic field sensing, and is widely used in various applications like electronic compasses, robotics, and other systems where orientation and navigation are important.
Key Features of GY-271 HMC5883L Module
The sensor can measure the magnetic field along the X, Y, and Z axes, making it ideal for detecting the orientation and direction of the sensor relative to Earth’s magnetic field.

The HMC5883L has a configurable sensitivity range of ±0.88 Gauss to ±8.1 Gauss, which determines how sensitive the sensor is to the Earth’s magnetic field. The default range is typically set to ±1.3 Gauss for most applications, providing good resolution for compass or heading applications.

The HMC5883L communicates with a microcontroller (like Arduino) using the I2C protocol. This makes it easy to connect and interact with microcontrollers, as only two wires (SCL and SDA) are needed for communication, in addition to power and ground.

The module operates with low power, making it suitable for battery-powered applications. It’s typically used in systems where power consumption is a concern, such as portable devices and mobile robotics.
The GY-271 module is small and easy to integrate into various projects. Its compact size makes it ideal for portable devices and systems with limited space.
The GY-271 module typically includes an onboard voltage regulator, so it can be powered by a range of voltages (usually 3.3V to 5V).

Calibration: The HMC5883L magnetometer requires calibration for accurate heading and orientation readings. To get accurate compass heading, you’ll need to calibrate the sensor by moving it in all directions to map the Earth’s magnetic field.

Interference: The sensor can be affected by local magnetic fields such as from motors, wires, or metal objects. It’s important to avoid placing the sensor near such sources of interference for best accuracy.
Power Supply: If you’re using the module in a battery-powered project, ensure that your power supply is stable and meets the voltage requirements (typically 3.3V to 5V).

blocks.text: The HCG FA screw-terminal aluminum electrolytic capacitor rated at 4700 µF and 450 V is engineered for demanding DC-link or high-voltage smoothing roles. It incorporates a robust aluminum can housing, a wound aluminum-foil dielectric and liquid electrolyte, combined with screw-post terminals to allow secure, heavy-duty connections. With a 450 V rating, it offers considerable head-room for converter, inverter and industrial power-electronics environments.

In operation, this capacitor serves as a bulk energy reservoir: it smooths substantial DC bus voltages, absorbs switching transients, delivers surge current, and mitigates ripple. The screw-terminal format ensures low internal resistance and inductance, facilitating rapid charge/discharge paths and making it suited for circuits with high ripple current and dynamic loads. Its form factor supports integration in power-electronic modules, traction drives or large UPS systems.

Mechanically this type is larger than lower-voltage equivalents, often with significant diameter and height to accommodate the capacitance and voltage rating. The screw posts suit lug, bus-bar or heavy-gauge connections rather than point leads. Because the lifetime of aluminum electrolytic capacitors is influenced by factors such as operating temperature, ripple current and mounting technique, careful thermal management, secure mechanical fixation and proper derating are key to achieving longevity and reliable performance in heavy-duty applications.

blocks.text: The JMX-94F-A-Z Latching Relay 12VDC 80A/220V is a high-current magnet latching relay designed for reliable switching in power control circuits. It uses a 12VDC coil and supports a heavy contact load up to 80A at 220VAC, making it suitable for applications that require strong load handling with stable switching performance. According to the PDF, the JMX-94F series is built with high sensitivity, high reliability, good anti-shock performance, and good anti-vibration performance.

This relay is a Single Coil Latching type, which means it can hold its contact position magnetically after receiving a control pulse. It does not need continuous coil power to remain in the set or reset state, helping reduce power consumption and heat during operation. The relay is pulse operated and designed for pulse control, with an ideal pulse duration of 50ms to 100ms for stable operation. The PDF also notes that latching relay coils should not be pulsed incorrectly, and the pulse width should be sufficient to ensure proper magnetic positioning.

The JMX-94F-A-Z model uses a 1A SPST-NO contact arrangement, with a dust cover enclosure and silver cadmium oxide contact material for heavy-load switching. The relay has an approximate operate time of 60ms and release/reset time of 20ms, allowing controlled switching in electrical power systems, meters, industrial control panels, and energy management circuits. With insulation resistance of 1000MΩ minimum, dielectric strength up to 4000VAC between contact and coil, and an operating temperature range from -25°C to +70°C, it is suitable for demanding control environments.

Built around an 8‑bit CPU core, the D8751H integrates core functions necessary for control tasks, combining computational performance with ease of interfacing and broad support for control applications. The device includes an on‑chip memory scheme that facilitates program storage and execution while offering compatibility with external memory devices for expanded applications. The architecture is based on the standard Intel 8051 instruction set, enabling effective byte processing, numerical operations and fast addressing modes for internal RAM access, which together allow developers to implement responsive control logic in hardware‑constrained systems.

blocks.text: IRF5210 P-Channel Power MOSFET Transistor 100V 40A 60mΩ TO-220

The IRF5210 is a P-Channel Power MOSFET born from International Rectifier’s fifth-generation HEXFET technology. This advanced manufacturing process is the core of its performance, enabling the integration of a powerful transistor into a compact silicon area. The focus of this technology is to fundamentally reduce electrical resistance when the device is switched on, which is a primary source of power loss and heat generation in such components.

Housed in the ubiquitous TO-220 package, the device is built for robustness and practical utility. This package is industry-standard for good reason: it offers an effective compromise between cost, physical size, and thermal performance. The design facilitates efficient transfer of heat from the silicon junction to a heatsink, which is crucial for maintaining reliability under continuous high-power operation. The transistor is also described as “fully avalanche rated,” indicating a rugged design that can withstand brief periods of high-voltage stress beyond its normal breakdown rating without failure.

In application, this combination of technology and design translates into a component known for efficient power control. Its fast switching capability allows it to transition rapidly between on and off states, minimizing transition losses a key factor in modern, efficient power circuits. The overall result is a power switch that provides designers with a dependable and effective means of controlling significant current levels, contributing to the stability and efficiency of the broader electronic system it serves.

Wireless charging technology can transfer power energy through medias such as air, paper, plastic, etc. This is a wireless charging module based on “magnetic-coupled resonance” technology that only consumes one-millionth of the power of traditional electromagnetic induction power technology. When the transmitter is electrified, it does not emit electromagnetic waves but forms a non-radiating field magnetic field around it. This magnetic field is used to connect with the receiving end and excite resonance at the receiver, by which the energy can be transmitted with minimal power consumption. Transmitting efficiency can reach up to 90%. What’s more, the magnetic field used in this technology is just as strong as the earth’s so it will not affect the human body or other devices.

This module is designed with the newly developed large current wireless power supply chip, and its circuit is pretty simple. Power the transmitting module with 12V, then the receiving end will output maximum 5V/2A power, which is applicable for small electronic products. Due to the non-contact charging design, the module can be completely sealed for being waterproof and dustproof, thus extending its service life and making it more convenient to use. The module can be used in phone power supply, portable device, 5V sensors, DIY wireless power, etc.

makers-56765.summary: The Water Level Float Switch Horizontal monitors water levels, activating pumps or alarms to prevent overflow or dry running in tanks and other water systems.

blocks.text: The Water Level Float Switch Horizontal is an essential device used to monitor and control the water levels in various water storage and pumping systems. It operates by detecting the rise and fall of water levels in a tank or well and is designed to automatically trigger a response, such as starting or stopping a pump, alarm, or valve. This ensures that water levels remain within a specified range, preventing issues such as overflow, dry running, or flooding.

Unlike vertical float switches, which function based on changes in water height along a vertical column, the horizontal float switch is designed to function across a tank’s surface, making it ideal for use in tanks with a broader width. It detects changes in water levels horizontally, ensuring that it works in environments where vertical space is limited or where a wider, more expansive surface area needs to be covered.

The operation of the horizontal float switch relies on a simple yet effective mechanism. As water levels rise, the float, which is typically buoyant, rises with the water. Once the float reaches a certain height, it activates the switch mechanism inside the float, either opening or closing the circuit. This action can trigger a pump to either start pumping out excess water or stop when the desired level is reached. The reverse action happens when the water level drops.

These switches are widely used in industrial, agricultural, and domestic applications. They are particularly useful in sump pumps to avoid flooding, water storage tanks to prevent overflow or dryness, and irrigation systems to maintain optimal water levels for crops. Built from corrosion-resistant materials, such as stainless steel or plastic, the horizontal float switch offers excellent durability and reliability in both freshwater and saltwater environments, ensuring consistent performance over time.

makers-621.summary: Arduino Pro Mini Atmega328PU-TH 5V/16MHz is basically an Uno or Nano which has been stripped down to its most basic configuration for the smallest size.

blocks.text: The Arduino Pro Mini ATmega328PU-TH 5V 16MHz is a compact microcontroller board engineered for advanced users who require a low-cost, minimalistic solution for their electronics projects. Built around the ATmega328P microcontroller, this board delivers the essential functionality of larger Arduino boards in a significantly reduced form factor, making it an excellent choice for applications where space is limited.
6 PWM shared with the digital I/O
8 Analog inputs of which 6 can also be used as digital I/O for a total of up to 20 digital I/O

The small size allows you to place the Pro Mini directly into your breadboard circuit. The small size also makes the Pro mini useful for putting down on a solder type breadboard for building into a permanent circuit.

The main impact to achieve this minimalistic state, is not having a built-in USB port. That means that a USB to serial converter needs to be used during the programming phase to download new code. The upside is the board is not carrying around an unneeded USB circuit and the resulting space, cost and power draw when it will not be used in the final application.
All the basic I/O of an Uno is still accessible on the Pro Mini. Most of these are available on the two rows of 1×12 header pins that can fit into a breadboard. There are a couple of exceptions.
Pins A4 and A5 which are also the I2C SDA/CLK pins are inside and offset from pins A2 and A3. To use these pins generally requires a header to be placed on the top side of the board.
Pins A6 and A7 which are analog inputs are located on the end of the board and similarly would require the pins to be on the top side of the board to use.
The board includes a 5V regulator and operates at 5V internally.
The pin labeled RAW is the same as VIN on most other boards. The voltage applied to this pin feeds the on-board 5V regulator. The input to this pin is typically 6V-12VDC.

The pins labeled VCC is on the output of the 5V regulator so 5V will be available on these pins when power is applied to the RAW input. 5V can also be applied directly to the Vcc pin instead of using the RAW input.
Note: It is important to not apply different voltages to both the RAW and VCC pins at the same time as the two power supplies will be shorted together.
The board ships with two 1×12 male headers which can be soldered to the sides of the board. in some applications it may be desirable to use wires or perhaps use female headers instead.
To ensure good alignment during soldering, first insert the loose headers into a solderless breadboard. The Pro Mini can then be placed on top of the headers and soldered into place.
The right-angle header can be optionally added to the end of the board for connection to a USB to TTL serial interface adapter to allow the module to be programmed.

Most microcontroller boards have a USB port built-in. This is very handy for any board that is used to run different programs at various times. If the board instead is going to be programmed once and then put into operation in a permanent circuit, the USB port adds cost, consumes power which can be important in a battery operated application and requires a larger PCB board to fit the parts. That’s where the Pro Mini comes into play.
Since the Pro Mini does not have a USB port built-in, to program it you will need to use a USB to Serial adapter that provides this functionality temporarily when you are programming the board.

If you have added the right angle header to the board and are using a USB to TTL adapter like the one at the bottom of the page which also has a right angle header, the modules can be easily connected by plugging them both into the same breadboard contacts with the boards facing each other. Female to female jumpers can also be used. The adapter in this case supplies 5V to the VCC pin to power the Pro Micro.
Some adapters come with a female header and can be plugged directly into the Pro Mini.
Once the adapter is connected, the board will program as normal using the Arduino IDE. Be sure to use the following settings and then select the COM port the Pro Mini is on.
Select “Arduino Pro or Pro Mini” as board type.
These are nice little clone assemblies with good build quality.
The Pro Mini works very well for embedding into long-term projects as it has a good price/performance trade-off.
If the goal is to do general prototyping, something like the Nano with a built-in USB has the same basic I/O and is a little easier to work with.

The Pro Micro is another option to consider. It has a similar form factor as the Pro Mini and has a built-in USB, but it is based on the Leonardo microcontroller which has some quirks related to using the USB. It is also a bit more expensive.

blocks.text: XUDA A5 Mini Wireless CarPlay Android Auto USB Adapter 2 in 1 Smart Mini Box

Instead of connecting your phone with a cable every time you enter the car, this mini USB adapter allows compatible vehicles to connect wirelessly after the first pairing setup.

The adapter is made for cars that already support original wired Apple CarPlay or wired Android Auto through the vehicle USB port. With a small USB-disk-style body, the A5 Mini can be plugged directly into the car USB port in the center console, dashboard, or armrest box depending on the vehicle design. FQPF6N90 ترانزستور MOSFET قدرة قناة N بجهد 900 فولت في باكيدج TO-220F، تيار 3.4 أمبير وقدرة تبديد 56 وات، بشحنة بوابة 40 نانو كولوم وتبديل سريع (زمن صعود 80 نانو ثانية).

blocks.text: FQPF6N90 High-Voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET (Enhancement Mode) – TO-220F

The FQPF6N90 is a high-voltage N-channel enhancement-mode power MOSFET designed for reliable switching in high-energy power circuits. With a 900V drain-to-source rating and a 3.4A continuous drain current, it’s a strong choice for applications that require efficient control of high-voltage loads, especially in compact power supply designs.

This MOSFET supports up to 56W maximum power dissipation, making it suitable for demanding thermal conditions when properly mounted and cooled. It also features a low gate charge (Qg = 40nC) which helps improve switching efficiency, and fast switching behavior with a rise time of 80ns, supporting cleaner transitions in high-frequency power stages.

In addition, the RDS(on) up to 1.9Ω and Coss of 140pF provide predictable performance during switching, while the ±30V gate-source limit and 150°C maximum junction temperature ensure durability in real-world designs. The device comes in a TO-220F package, which offers good isolation and practical mounting for power electronics projects.
ترانزستور MOSFET قدرة عالي الجهد FQPF6N90 – قناة N (تشغيل بالتعزيز) – TO-220F

يُعد FQPF6N90 ترانزستور قدرة من نوع MOSFET قناة N بنمط التشغيل بالتعزيز، ومُصمم للعمل بكفاءة داخل دوائر القدرة ذات الجهد العالي. يتميز بتحمل جهد بين المصرف والمصدر حتى 900 فولت مع تيار مصرف أقصى 3.4 أمبير، مما يجعله مناسبًا للتحكم في الأحمال عالية الجهد داخل تطبيقات القدرة المختلفة.

يدعم هذا المكوّن قدرة تبديد حراري تصل إلى 56 وات (حسب ظروف التبريد والتركيب)، كما يتميز بشحنة بوابة منخفضة نسبيًا (40 نانو كولوم) تساعد على تحسين كفاءة التبديل وتقليل الفاقد. ويقدم أيضًا أداءً سريعًا في التبديل مع زمن صعود 80 نانو ثانية، ما يجعله مناسبًا لدوائر التقطيع ومراحل القدرة التي تعمل بترددات أعلى.

بالإضافة إلى ذلك، توفر قيمة مقاومة التشغيل حتى 1.9 أوم مع سعة خرج 140 بيكو فاراد أداءً متوقعًا أثناء التبديل، مع قدرة تحمل جهد بوابة حتى ±30 فولت ودرجة حرارة وصلة قصوى 150 درجة مئوية لزيادة الاعتمادية. يأتي في باكيدج TO-220F المعزول والعملي للتركيب في دوائر القدرة.

ekostra-2412.summary: ✅ 500K ohm 3-pin potentiometer ✅ 15mm shaft length for easy handling ✅ Smooth rotation, approx. 270° ✅ Through-hole mounting type ✅ Suitable for analog input adjustments

blocks.text: This 500K Ohm rotary potentiometer has 3 pins and a 15mm shaft. It works as an adjustable voltage divider: turning the knob moves the wiper and changes the voltage on the middle pin. The high 500K value is a good fit for high-impedance circuits, long timing adjustments and audio level controls where very little current should flow through the pot.
Resistance: 500K Ohm (between the two outer pins)
Pins: 3 (two ends and a middle wiper)
As a variable resistor (rheostat), use the middle pin and one outer pin only.
Adjustable timing with a 555 timer (long delays with a small capacitor)
Gain and level adjustment in high-impedance audio and op-amp circuits
With 5V across it, only 10 µA flows through the track, so it uses almost no power.
For reading a knob with an Arduino analog input, a 10K pot gives more stable readings; a 500K pot can work but may need a 100nF capacitor from the wiper to GND to reduce noise.

ekostra-3105.summary: 33uF 50V Radial Electrolytic Capacitor 1. Capacitance: 33µF 2. Voltage Rating: 50V DC 3. Capacitance Tolerance: ±20% (typical) 4. Mounting Type: Through-Hole Radial 5. Operating Temperature: -40°C to +85°C 6. Polarity: Polarized (marked case)

blocks.text: This 33µF 50V radial electrolytic capacitor is a compact high-voltage storage component for decoupling and filtering in 24V to 48V systems. The 50V DC rating supports industrial and automotive power buses, while the 33µF value provides sufficient capacitance for local bypass and noise suppression at the point-of-load in moderate-impedance circuits.

Using polarized aluminum electrolytic construction with radial leads, this capacitor is designed for vertical through-hole PCB mounting. The high voltage rating in a small capacitance value makes it suitable for applications requiring voltage endurance without substantial bulk storage.
Radial leads for standard PCB mounting
Low ESR for effective noise filtering
Ideal for industrial control and automotive circuits

The ELM327 V1.5 OBD2 WiFi Interface Car Diagnostic Scanner is a wireless adapter built around the ELM327 chipset, letting a phone, tablet, or laptop read a vehicle’s OBD-II data over a local WiFi hotspot. It plugs directly into the 16-pin OBD-II port and works with popular diagnostic apps for iOS, Android, and Windows.
ELM327 Chipset: Firmware V1.5 for broad OBD-II protocol coverage and stable WiFi communication.
WiFi Connectivity: Creates its own WiFi hotspot, compatible with iOS, Android, and Windows diagnostic apps.
Universal OBD-II Support: Compatible with ISO9141, KWP2000, J1850 PWM/VPW, and CAN protocols.
Fault Code Reading: Reads and clears diagnostic trouble codes and turns off the Check Engine light.
Live Data Streaming: Displays real-time RPM, coolant temperature, speed, and fuel trim data.
Plug-and-Play Design: Draws power directly from the OBD-II port, no external cables or batteries needed.
